description.value: The Hilltop Inn is a full-service hotel on the Trans-Canada Highway in Salmon Arm, offering rooms with views of Shuswap Lake, the surrounding forest, and a seasonal outdoor pool. Room categories range from Queen Executive to a 660 sq ft Junior Suite, all with in-room appliances and pillow-top mattresses. Situated along a major touring corridor in the Okanagan/Thompson region, it provides a comfortable basecamp for cyclists riding the TransCanada route.
